A live video feed captured by a video capturing device is received and its presentation on client devices is enhanced by inserting and managing multiple content items. This indicates development of interactive, cloud mediated video presentation experiences and dynamic content overlays to improve audience engagement in live presentations and real time communication.

overview_description.description:
Prezi is an interactive cloud-based presentation platform that helps users connect with their audience. Prezi's latest offering, Prezi Next, is a full-lifecycle presentation platform so everyone can easily create visually stunning presentations, deliver them in a more natural and conversational way, and analyze their effectiveness.

It was founded in 2008 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.
